name: Hard Cut
description: Instantaneous transition between two camera angles or media assets on an audio pause boundary.
good_when: Moving from presenter claim to property proof
Switching between distinct rooms on phrase breaks
avoid_when: Presenter is in the middle of a continuous emotional sentence (unless motivating an intentional punch)
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Mid-syllable cutting without acoustic pause
requires_media_or_context: Two clean footage sources with clear audio pause boundary
evidence_source: Universal in 88.7% of shots across REF_01-05

name: Visual Hold
description: Deliberate continuation of the current visual framing and media asset across narrative sentences.
good_when: Presenter delivery is deeply engaging
Property shot is exceptionally beautiful and deserves contemplation
avoid_when: Visual framing has become stale and viewer attention risks dropping
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: High-energy fast pitch where pace demands visual resets
requires_media_or_context: High-quality source performance or aesthetic imagery

name: Cutaway
description: Brief insertion of a related visual detail, feature, or symbolic proof before returning to the main line.
good_when: A specific feature or pain item is uttered (grill, sink, fixture)
avoid_when: No relevant asset exists; cutting to random filler degrades trust
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Overly fragmented cutaways that break narrative train of thought
requires_media_or_context: Specific detail asset matching spoken entity

name: Digital Scale Punch-In
description: Instantaneous crop/scale increase on the presenter centered on eye-line on an emphatic word break.
good_when: Presenter delivers a key revelation, thesis statement, or objection break
avoid_when: Source footage has low resolution or presenter face is partially occluded
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Slow luxury tour where sudden jump crops disrupt serenity

name: Subtle Reframe / Alternate Framing
description: Gentle shift in framing, crop position, or multi-camera cut to give visual variety during longer monologues.
good_when: Presenter is explaining a multi-step concept in a conversational tone
avoid_when: Sharp punch-in is needed for sudden dramatic shock
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Very short 1-second shots

name: Presenter with Graphic Overlay
description: Presenter remains visible while a side card, badge, or metric appears beside them in active safe area.
good_when: Presenter cites price, financial conditions, or size specs
avoid_when: Graphic occludes presenter face or eyes
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Presenter framed dead-center without horizontal room for card
requires_media_or_context: Presenter footage with lateral framing margin

name: Hero Property Shot
description: Expansive, perfectly framed footage of the main living room, balcony vista, or exterior facade.
good_when: Executing initial REVEAL or showcasing key architectural asset
avoid_when: Speaker is discussing complex financing that requires graphical focus
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Poor lighting or messy unfinished staging
requires_media_or_context: Top tier aesthetic video or photo asset
evidence_source: REF_03 facade, REF_05 living room reveal

name: Property B-Roll Cutaway
description: Clean video coverage of a specific room or property area synchronized to speech mention.
good_when: Speaker names a room or feature (kitchen, suites, leisure area)
avoid_when: Asset quality is sub-par or unaligned with script
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Unmotivated cutaway when presenter should hold attention
requires_media_or_context: Analyzed property video or photo asset

name: Macro / Detail Finish Shot
description: Tight close-up highlighting fixtures, stone textures, glass railings, barbecue grill, or cabinetry.
good_when: Highlighting finish quality, decoration, or premium materials
avoid_when: Viewer still lacks basic spatial understanding of the room layout
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Grainy or out-of-focus macro photos

name: Dynamic Synchronized Captions
description: Subtitles displayed centrally in the bottom safe area synchronized word-by-word with speech.
good_when: Always active for accessibility and silent feed comprehension
avoid_when: Occluding key product details or platform UI
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Placement over bottom UI controls (lower 250px without margin)

name: Keyword Color / Scale Emphasis
description: Highlighting emphasized nouns, verbs, and figures in high-contrast brand accent color within captions.
good_when: Speaker vocalizes key values, room names, or emotional terms
avoid_when: Overused on every single word (destroys hierarchy)
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Low contrast color choices against video background

name: Hero Number Typography
description: Large, clean typographic treatment of a pivotal metric (price, down payment, square meters).
good_when: Communicating key commercial anchor ("R$ 350.000", "68m²", "R$ 2.000/mês")
avoid_when: Minor non-essential numbers that clutter comprehension
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Multiple competing large numbers on screen at once

name: Lower-Third Room / Feature Badge
description: Subtle semi-transparent pill badge in lower corner identifying room name and dimension.
good_when: Entering a new room in b-roll or walkthrough
avoid_when: Presenter is speaking fullscreen in studio
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Colliding with caption safe zone

name: Commercial Condition / Price Card
description: Polished graphic card summarizing total price, down payment, installment flow, or program financing.
good_when: Speaker details complete financial structure
avoid_when: Emotional storytelling hook where financial cards feel premature
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Overloaded spreadsheet-style cards with tiny unreadable text

name: Amenity / Feature Pill Badge
description: Compact icon + text badge popping onto screen to highlight key amenities (24h security, pool, elevator).
good_when: Rapidly listing multiple development amenities
avoid_when: Covering critical parts of the footage
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: More than 2 badges simultaneous on mobile portrait

name: Location Drone / Aerial Context
description: High-altitude drone shot showing shoreline, urban neighborhood, major avenues, or surrounding greenery.
good_when: Mentioning city, neighborhood prestige, or beach distance
avoid_when: Discussing interior room finish details
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Unrelated stock drone footage of different cities
requires_media_or_context: Aerial drone footage of the actual location

name: Point of Interest Visual / Distance Callout
description: Visual asset or badge highlighting proximity to key landmarks (shopping malls, supermarkets, highways).
good_when: Script cites specific landmarks (e.g. "Taubaté Shopping", "Shibata", "Dutra")
High evidence need on location claims
avoid_when: Landmark is unknown or lacks commercial/lifestyle appeal
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Generic unbranded street photos

name: Slow Ken Burns Push / Pan
description: Subtle 1.05x zoom or slow pan applied to still photography or static footage to maintain kinetic life.
good_when: Displaying high-resolution still photos of rooms or renders
avoid_when: Source photo resolution is too low for crop without artifacting
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Fast jerky motion on static photos

name: Adaptive Music Bed
description: Instrumental music track providing emotional foundation, dynamically ducked under speech.
good_when: Continuous throughout entire video
avoid_when: Loud abrasive music that masks vocal intelligibility
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Vocal tracks in background competing with presenter

name: Transition / Accent SFX
description: Short subtle acoustic accent (whoosh, subtle click, gentle riser) punctuating a major visual change.
good_when: Accompanying major punch-in, price card reveal, or section break
avoid_when: Overused on every single cut (causes acoustic irritation)
incompatible_or_risky_contexts: Loud high-gain sound effects
